pages.title: Shine Your Light
pages.child_instruction: Color the children carrying lanterns to the church fall festival.
pages.bible_connection: The lanterns remind us that Jesus said to let our light shine by doing good.
pages.visual_prompt: Integrated black line-art coloring scene: church fall festival, two children carrying lanterns, pumpkins, leaves, church with intact steeple cross, string lights, welcome table. No letters in the artwork.

pages.title: Find the Festival Gifts
pages.child_instruction: Find and circle all 8 gifts. Each one can help you remember to shine God's light by doing good.
pages.bible_connection: Looking carefully for each gift is practice for noticing good things we can do.
pages.visual_prompt: Controlled festival-grounds background without the eight targets. Independently placed lantern, pumpkin, apple, leaf, acorn, scarf, basket, and Bible.

pages.title: Bring Your Lantern
pages.child_instruction: Start at the child. Follow the hedge path to the welcome table.
pages.bible_connection: Bringing the lantern to the table is a picture of taking God's light to people.
pages.visual_prompt: One garden scene: child with lantern at the hedge opening, unique maze path, welcome table at the church festival. Not a maze pasted on a blank page.

pages.title: How Can You Shine This Week?
pages.child_instruction: Check the ways you can shine. Then draw yourself inside the lantern.
pages.bible_connection: These good works are how a child can let light shine, as Matthew 5:16 teaches.
pages.visual_prompt: One lantern-framed page: four illustrated choices, a large lantern drawing area, and a short prayer ribbon.
pages.prayer: Jesus, help me shine Your light.
